wikipediaArticleRead.support: L106–107 discusses Zeruah in relation to Jeroboam and quotes 1 Kings 11:26. The article notes an alternate reading that makes her Nebat’s mother; the pinned WEB wording attaches “whose mother’s name was Zeruah” to Jeroboam, and the profile follows that wording.

sourceTextExcerpts.text: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
